# Demo Co

## Overview
Calm, trustworthy, practical. Infographics explain one idea for small-business owners.

## Colors
Primary blue for titles, markers and key words; ink for body text; tint and cell greys for quiet panels.

## Typography
DejaVu Sans throughout. Title 48, headings 32, body 28. Sentence case everywhere.

## Layout
1200px wide canvas, 80px page padding, light blue title bar across the top.

## Shapes
Circles for numbered markers, 20px rounded cards, dashed connectors between steps.
